# DualImpactEvaluation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework for simultaneously assessing both beneficial and adverse effects of nanomaterials on health and environment within a single experimental or computational setup. Critical for ensuring that nanotechnologies used in neural interfaces or in-network devices do not introduce unintended ecological or physiological risks.
